caption: Apna Janma Nakshatra kaise nikaalte hain? 🌙✨ Sirf 3 cheezein chahiye: birth date, exact time aur birthplace. 🔭 Logic simple hai: • 360° zodiac circle → 12 Rashi, har ek 30° • 27 Nakshatra, har ek 13°20′ • Har Nakshatra ke 4 Paya (jinhe Pada / quarter bhi kehte hain), har Paya 3°20′ • Astronomy Moon ki tropical longitude deti hai. Vedic Jyotish sidereal use karta hai. Sidereal = Tropical − Ayanamsha (Lahiri ≈ 24°) 🧮 Example: Moon ki sidereal longitude 45° → Nakshatra: Rohini → Paya: 2 → Rashi: Vrishabha ⚠️ Birth time pakka nahi hai? Toh boundary ke paas Paya badal sakta hai. 👇 Comment mein apna Nakshatra aur Paya batao. Reel save kar lo, kundli banate waqt kaam aayegi! Rashi, Nakshatra, Pada… kundli mein ye teen shabd sabne dekhe hain, par inka aapas mein connection kya hai? 🌌 Ek hi 360° ka aasmaani circle, teen layers mein: ♈ 12 Rashi: har ek 30° 🌙 27 Nakshatra: har ek 13°20′, jinhe “lunar mansions” kehte hain ✨ 108 Pada: har ek 3°20′ (27 × 4) Vedic tradition mein har Pada ek Navamsha sign se juda hai, jo D-9 chart tak le jaata hai. Janam ke waqt Moon jis Nakshatra aur Pada mein ho, usi se tradition ke hisaab se Vimshottari Dasha ka starting point nikalta hai, aur kai parivaron mein naam ka pehla akshar bhi. 12 zodiac signs… par rulers sirf 7! 🌙☀️ Yeh wheel itna perfect fit kaise hota hai? Traditional astrology mein: ☀️ Sun → Leo (Simha) 🌙 Moon → Cancer (Kark) Baaki paanch planets speed ke order mein, dono taraf ek-ek sign lete hain: ☿ Mercury → Gemini & Virgo ♀ Venus → Taurus & Libra ♂ Mars → Aries & Scorpio ♃ Jupiter → Sagittarius & Pisces ♄ Saturn → Capricorn & Aquarius, bilkul lights ke saamne Wheel ko fold karo, aur har planet apne doosre sign se mil jaata hai. ✨ Yeh ek traditional, symbolic model hai, astronomy ka physical map nahi. Rahu-Ketu grah hain… ya kuch aur? 🌑🌕 Amavasya har mahine aati hai, phir bhi har baar surya grahan kyun nahi lagta? 🤔 Jawab hai Moon ke raaste mein. Woh Suraj ke raaste se lagbhag 5° jhuka hua hai, isliye dono raaste sirf do points par milte hain. Grahan tabhi lagta hai jab Amavasya ya Purnima in do points ke paas pade. ✨ Jyotish parampara mein inhi do points ko Rahu aur Ketu kaha gaya. 🔭 Is reel mein: • Surya grahan vs chandra grahan • Chandra grahan mein Moon laal kyun dikh sakta hai • Poora andhera kitni der rehta hai: surya grahan mein lagbhag saadhe saat minute tak, chandra grahan mein lagbhag 1 ghanta 47 minute tak Toh Rahu-Ketu koi grah nahi, Moon ke raaste ke do points hain. Astronomy batati hai kya hota hai, parampara batati hai use kya naam diya gaya. 💬 Comment karo: aapne aakhri grahan kab dekha tha? 📌 Save karo aur us dost ko bhejo jo har grahan par Rahu-Ketu ki baat karta hai! #TheCosmicVoid #RahuKetu #Eclipse #Astronomy #grahan
